description: MVFA-AD medical anomaly detection. Input one medical image and optional anatomical object, output anomaly score and heatmap.

name: Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC)
description: The Absolute Neutrophil Count (ANC) is frequently used to assess neutropenic fever in chemotherapy patients.

input_schema.name: neutrophils
input_schema.description: Percentage of mature segmented neutrophils (PMNs) from CBC differential. Unit: %. Valid range: 0–100 %.

input_schema.name: bands
input_schema.description: Percentage of immature band neutrophils from CBC differential. Unit: %. Valid range: 0–30 %.

input_schema.name: white_blood_cell_count
input_schema.description: WBC count entered per 1000 (i.e., × 10³ cells/µL). Enter as 8.4, NOT 8400. Unit: × 10³ cells/µL (= × 10⁹ cells/L). Valid range: 0.1–100 × 10³ cells/µL.

name: APGAR Score
description: The APGAR Score assesses neonates vitality at 1 and 5 minutes after birth.

input_schema.name: activity
input_schema.description: Activity/muscle tone.
input_schema.options: Active (2 pts), Some extremity flexion (1 pt), Limp (0 pts)

input_schema.name: pulse
input_schema.description: Pulse/heart rate.
input_schema.options: ≥100 BPM (2 pts), <100 BPM (1 pt), Absent (0 pts)

input_schema.name: grimace
input_schema.description: Grimace/reflex irritability response to stimulation.
input_schema.options: Sneeze/cough (2 pts), Grimace (1 pt), None (0 pts)

input_schema.name: appearance
input_schema.description: Appearance/skin color.
input_schema.options: All pink (2 pts), Blue extremities, pink body (1 pt), Blue/pale (0 pts)

input_schema.name: respirations
input_schema.description: Respiratory effort.
input_schema.options: Good/crying (2 pts), Irregular/slow (1 pt), Absent (0 pts)

name: Basal Energy Expenditure
description: The Basal Energy Expenditure calculates daily energy expenditure.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Biological sex of the patient.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kilograms (kg).

input_schema.name: height
input_schema.description: Patient height in centimeters (cm).

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years.

input_schema.name: activity
input_schema.description: Activity level for Harris-Benedict adjustment.
input_schema.options: Sedentary (little to no exercise), Light exercise (1-3 days per week), Moderate exercise (3–5 days per week), Heavy exercise (6–7 days per week), Very heavy exercise (twice per day, extra heavy workouts)

name: Bicarbonate Deficit
description: The Bicarbonate Deficit calculator calculates the total body bicarbonate deficit.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Body weight in kilograms (kg). Valid range: 1–226.796 kg.

input_schema.name: bicarbonate

name: BMI Calculator (Body Mass Index and BSA)
description: Enter the patient’s height and weight in the BMI Calculator to calculate the Body Mass Index based on the estimated body fat.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kilograms (kg). Valid range: 0.5–226.796 kg.

input_schema.name: height
input_schema.description: Patient height in centimeters (cm). Valid range: 12.7–203.2 cm.

input_schema.name: target
input_schema.description: Target BMI in kg/m² used to determine the weight required to achieve that BMI. Valid range: 10–30 kg/m². Defaults to None (not computed).

name: Calcium Correction for Hypoalbuminemia and Hyperalbuminemia
description: The Calcium Correction for Hypoalbuminemia calculates a corrected calcium level for patients with hypoalbuminemia.

input_schema.name: calcium
input_schema.description: Serum calcium in mmol/L. Valid range: 1.5–3.25 mmol/L (equivalent to 6–13 mg/dL).

input_schema.name: albumin
input_schema.description: Patient's serum albumin in g/L. Valid range: 10–60 g/L (equivalent to 1–6 g/dL).

input_schema.name: normal_albumin
input_schema.description: Reference normal albumin in g/L. Typical value is 40 g/L (4 g/dL). Valid range: 10–60 g/L (equivalent to 1–6 g/dL).

name: PSI/PORT Score: Pneumonia Severity Index for CAP
description: The PSI/PORT Score: Pneumonia Severity Index for Adult CAP estimates mortality for adult patients with community-acquired pneumonia.

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Patient biological sex.

input_schema.name: nursing_home
input_schema.description: Nursing home resident.

input_schema.name: neoplastic
input_schema.description: Neoplastic disease (active cancer or diagnosed within 1 yr).

input_schema.name: liver
input_schema.description: Liver disease history (clinical/histologic diagnosis of cirrhosis or chronic active hepatitis).

input_schema.name: chf
input_schema.description: Congestive heart failure history (documented systolic or diastolic ventricular dysfunction).

input_schema.name: cerebrovascular
input_schema.description: Cerebrovascular disease history (documented stroke or TIA).

input_schema.name: renal
input_schema.description: Renal disease history (documented chronic renal disease or abnormal BUN/creatinine).

input_schema.name: altered_mental
input_schema.description: Altered mental status on examination (disorientation, stupor, or coma).

input_schema.name: respiratory_rate_29
input_schema.description: Respiratory rate ≥30 breaths/min.

input_schema.name: systolic_bp_90
input_schema.description: Systolic blood pressure <90 mmHg.

input_schema.name: temperature_35
input_schema.description: Temperature <35°C (95°F) or >39.9°C (103.8°F).

input_schema.name: pulse_124
input_schema.description: Pulse ≥125 beats/min.

input_schema.name: ph_7
input_schema.description: Arterial pH <7.35.

input_schema.name: bun_29

input_schema.name: sodium_130

input_schema.name: glucose_249
input_schema.description: Glucose ≥250 mg/dL (≥14 mmol/L).

input_schema.name: hematocrit_30
input_schema.description: Hematocrit <30%.

input_schema.name: oxygen_pressure_60
input_schema.description: Partial pressure of O₂ <60 mmHg (<8 kPa).

input_schema.name: pleural_effusion
input_schema.description: Pleural effusion on chest x-ray.

name: Framingham Risk Score for Hard Coronary Heart Disease
description: The Framingham Coronary Heart Disease Risk Score estimates risk of heart attack in 10 years.

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years. Valid range: 30–79 years.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Biological sex of the patient.

input_schema.name: smoker
input_schema.description: Current cigarette smoker status.

input_schema.name: cholesterol
input_schema.description: Total cholesterol in mmol/L. Valid range: 2.586–12.93 mmol/L (equivalent to 100–500 mg/dL). Internally converted to mg/dL for formula.

input_schema.name: hdl_cholesterol
input_schema.description: HDL cholesterol in mmol/L. Valid range: 0.02586–3.879 mmol/L (equivalent to 1–150 mg/dL). Internally converted to mg/dL for formula.

input_schema.name: systolic_bp
input_schema.description: Systolic blood pressure in mm Hg. Valid range: 40–250 mm Hg.

input_schema.name: blood_pressure
input_schema.description: Whether blood pressure is currently being treated with medicines.

name: CHADS₂ Score for Atrial Fibrillation Stroke Risk
description: The CHADS2 score estimates stroke risk in patients with atrial fibrillation.

input_schema.name: heart_failure
input_schema.description: History of congestive heart failure.

input_schema.name: hypertension
input_schema.description: History of hypertension.

input_schema.name: age_75
input_schema.description: Age ≥ 75 years.

input_schema.name: diabetes
input_schema.description: History of diabetes mellitus.

input_schema.name: stroke
input_schema.description: Prior stroke or TIA symptoms.

name: Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft-Gault Equation)
description: The Cockcroft-Gault Equation predicts Creatinine Clearance from serum Creatinine.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Patient biological sex.

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Actual body weight in kg (SI).

input_schema.name: creatinine
input_schema.description: Serum creatinine in µmol/L (SI).

input_schema.name: height
input_schema.description: Patient height in cm (SI). When provided, ideal body weight (IBW) and adjusted body weight (ABW) are calculated and used for obese patients.

name: Corrected QT Interval (QTc)
description: The Corrected QT Interval (QTc) adjusts the QT interval correctly for heart rate extremes.

input_schema.name: formula
input_schema.description: Formula to use for correction. Valid options: 'Bazett', 'Fridericia', 'Framingham', 'Hodges', 'Rautaharju'. Bazett tends to over-correct at high heart rates.

input_schema.name: heart_rate
input_schema.description: Heart rate in beats/min (SI). Valid range: 20–200 beats/min.

input_schema.name: speed
input_schema.description: ECG paper speed in mm/sec. Options: '25' or '50'. Determines which QT interval input and conversion applies. At 25 mm/sec, 1 small box = 40 msec (use qt_interval). At 50 mm/sec, 1 small box = 20 msec (use qt_interval2).

input_schema.name: qt_interval
input_schema.description: QT interval in msec (SI) for 25 mm/sec paper. 1 small ECG box = 40 msec. Valid range: 0–26000 msec. Required when speed is '25'.

input_schema.name: qt_interval2
input_schema.description: QT interval in msec (SI) for 50 mm/sec paper. 1 small ECG box = 20 msec. Valid range: 0–13000 msec. Required when speed is '50'.

name: Sodium Correction for Hyperglycemia
description: The Sodium Correction for Hyperglycemia Calculates the actual sodium level in patients with hyperglycemia.

input_schema.name: sodium
input_schema.description: Measured serum sodium in mmol/L (equivalent to mEq/L). Valid range: 0–170 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: glucose
input_schema.description: Serum glucose in mmol/L (SI unit). Valid range: 2.775–55.5 mmol/L (equivalent to 50–1000 mg/dL). Conversion used internally: mg/dL = mmol/L / 0.0555.

name: Maddrey's Discriminant Function for Alcoholic Hepatitis
description: The Maddrey’s Discriminant Function suggests which patients with alcoholic hepatitis may have a poor prognosis and benefit from steroid administration.

input_schema.name: pt
input_schema.description: Patient's prothrombin time in seconds (SI: sec).

input_schema.name: pt_control
input_schema.description: Control/reference prothrombin time in seconds (SI: sec).

input_schema.name: bilirubin
input_schema.description: Total bilirubin in µmol/L (SI).
input_schema.options: Valid range: 0–342.08 µmol/L (equivalent to 0–20 mg/dL). Conversion: 1 mg/dL = 17.104 µmol/L.

name: Pediatric Endotracheal Tube (ETT) Size
description: The Pediatric Endotracheal Tube (ETT) Size estimates ET tube size based on age.

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years. Valid range: 0.1–100 years. This calculator is intended for pediatric patients; use clinical judgment for adolescents approaching adult sizing.

name: Fractional Excretion of Sodium (FENa)
description: The Fractional Excretion of Sodium (FENa) determines if renal failure is due to pre-renal, intrinsic, or post-renal pathology.

input_schema.name: sodium
input_schema.description: Serum sodium in mmol/L (equivalent to mEq/L). Valid range: 0–170 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: creatinine
input_schema.description: Serum creatinine in µmol/L. Valid range: 0–884 µmol/L (0–10 mg/dL). Conversion: µmol/L = mg/dL × 88.4.

input_schema.name: urine_sodium
input_schema.description: Urine sodium in mmol/L (equivalent to mEq/L). Valid range: 1–260 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: urine_creatinine
input_schema.description: Urine creatinine in µmol/L. Valid range: 88.4–39780 µmol/L (1–450 mg/dL). Conversion: µmol/L = mg/dL × 88.4.

name: Fractional Excretion of Urea (FEUrea)
description: The Fractional Excretion of Urea (FEUrea) determines the cause of renal failure. Similar to the FENa, but can be used on patients on diuretics.

input_schema.name: bun
input_schema.description: BUN or serum urea concentration in mmol/L (SI). Clinical range: 0.714–107.1 mmol/L (equivalent to 2–300 mg/dL). Note: If value was measured in mg/dL, convert: mmol/L = mg/dL × 0.357

input_schema.name: creatinine
input_schema.description: Serum creatinine concentration in µmol/L (SI). Clinical range: >0–884 µmol/L (equivalent to >0–10 mg/dL). Note: If value was measured in mg/dL, convert: µmol/L = mg/dL × 88.4

input_schema.name: urine_urea
input_schema.description: Urine urea concentration in mmol/L (SI). Clinical range: 0.357–249.9 mmol/L (equivalent to 1–700 mg/dL). Note: If value was measured in mg/dL, convert: mmol/L = mg/dL × 0.357

input_schema.name: urine_creatinine
input_schema.description: Urine creatinine concentration in µmol/L (SI). Clinical range: 88.4–39780 µmol/L (equivalent to 1–450 mg/dL). Note: If value was measured in mg/dL, convert: µmol/L = mg/dL × 88.4

name: Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS)
description: The Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) estimates impaired consciousness and coma severity based on response to defined stimuli including Eye, Verbal, and Motor criteria.

input_schema.name: eye
input_schema.description: Best eye response.
input_schema.options: Spontaneously (+4), To verbal command (+3), To pain (+2), No eye opening (+1), Not testable (NT)

input_schema.name: verbal
input_schema.description: Best verbal response.
input_schema.options: Oriented (+5), Confused (+4), Inappropriate words (+3), Incomprehensible sounds (+2), No verbal response (+1), Not testable/intubated (NT)

input_schema.name: motor
input_schema.description: Best motor response.
input_schema.options: Obeys commands (+6), Localizes pain (+5), Withdrawal from pain (+4), Flexion to pain (+3), Extension to pain (+2), No motor response (+1), Not testable (NT)

name: Ideal Body Weight and Adjusted Body Weight
description: The Ideal Body Weight calculator calculates ideal body weight by the Devine formula.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Patient biological sex.

input_schema.name: height
input_schema.description: Patient height in centimeters (cm). Valid range: 121.92–203.2 cm (48–80 inches). Formula is most reliable at >= 152.4 cm (60 inches / 5 feet).

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient actual body weight in kilograms (kg). Optional; used only to calculate adjusted body weight (ABW) in obese patients (actual weight > IBW). Valid range: 1.0–226.796 kg. Pass None to omit.

name: LDL Calculated
description: The LDL Calculated calculates LDL based on total and HDL cholesterol and triglycerides.

input_schema.name: total_cholesterol
input_schema.description: Total serum cholesterol in mmol/L. Valid range: 2.586–12.93 mmol/L (100–500 mg/dL).

input_schema.name: hdl_cholesterol
input_schema.description: High-density lipoprotein cholesterol in mmol/L. Must not exceed total cholesterol. Valid range: 0.02586–3.879 mmol/L (1–150 mg/dL).

input_schema.name: triglycerides
input_schema.description: Fasting serum triglycerides in mmol/L. Must be measured fasting for accurate results. Valid range: 0.0–3.39 mmol/L (0–300 mg/dL).

name: Maintenance Fluids Calculations
description: The Maintenance Fluids Calculator calculates maintenance fluid requirements by weight.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kg. Must be > 0 and <= 272.16 kg (equivalent to 0–600 lbs). In obese patients, consider using ideal body weight instead of actual body weight.

name: Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP)
description: The Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) calculates mean arterial pressure from measured systolic and diastolic blood pressure values.

input_schema.name: systolic_blood_pressure
input_schema.description: Systolic blood pressure in mm Hg. Valid range: 40–250 mm Hg.

input_schema.name: diastolic_blood_pressure
input_schema.description: Diastolic blood pressure in mm Hg. Valid range: 20–180 mm Hg.

name: MDRD GFR Equation
description: The MDRD GFR Equation estimates glomerular filtration rate based on creatinine and patient characteristics.

input_schema.name: sex
input_schema.description: Patient biological sex.

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years.

input_schema.name: creatinine
input_schema.description: Serum creatinine in µmol/L (SI units).

input_schema.name: black_race
input_schema.description: Whether the patient is of Black race.

name: MELD Na (UNOS/OPTN)
description: The MELD Na Score (UNOS/OPTN) quantifies end-stage liver disease for transplant planning with addition of sodium.

input_schema.name: dialysis
input_schema.description: Whether the patient is on dialysis at least twice in the past week, or CVVHD for ≥24 hours in the past week.
input_schema.options: "No" or "Yes". If "Yes", creatinine is set to 4.0 mg/dL.

input_schema.name: creatinine
input_schema.description: Serum creatinine in µmol/L (SI). Valid range: 0–884 µmol/L (0–10 mg/dL). Values exceeding 353.6 µmol/L (4.0 mg/dL) are automatically capped at 4.0 mg/dL per UNOS/OPTN rules.

input_schema.name: bilirubin
input_schema.description: Total serum bilirubin in µmol/L (SI). Valid range: 0–342.08 µmol/L (0–20 mg/dL).

input_schema.name: inr
input_schema.description: International Normalized Ratio (INR). Valid range: 0.5–10. Values below 1.0 are set to 1.0 for the calculation.

input_schema.name: na
input_schema.description: Serum sodium in mmol/L (SI; numerically equivalent to mEq/L). Valid range: 0–170 mmol/L. Values <125 mmol/L are set to 125 and values >137 mmol/L are set to 137 for the sodium adjustment step.

name: Oxygenation Index
description: The Oxygenation Index Predicts outcomes, especially in pediatric patients by helping to determine need for ECMO.

input_schema.name: o2_fraction
input_schema.description: FiO₂, fraction of inhaled oxygen expressed as a percentage (%). Valid range: 20–100 %.

input_schema.name: mean_airway_pressure
input_schema.description: Mean airway pressure (PAW) in cm H₂O. Valid range: 0.013595–54.38 cm H₂O (equivalent to 0.01–40 mm Hg). Note: MDCalc UI accepts mm Hg; this function expects SI unit cm H₂O.

input_schema.name: partial_pressure_oxygen
input_schema.description: Partial pressure of arterial oxygen (PaO2) in kPa. Valid range: 1.33–79.80 kPa (equivalent to 10–600 mm Hg).

name: Parkland Formula for Burns
description: Calculates fluid requirements for burn patients in a 24-hour period.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kg. Valid range: 1–300 kg.

input_schema.name: percentage_body_burned
input_schema.description: Estimated percentage of total body surface area (TBSA) burned, excluding 1st-degree burns, in %. Valid range: 1–100 %.

name: Pediatric Ins and Outs
description: The Pediatric Ins and Outs (per kg and per hour) calculates fluid status in volume per weight & volume per weight per time, for pediatrics.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kilograms (SI). Valid range: 0.226796–226.796 kg (equivalent to 0.5–500 lbs). Use clinical judgment; realistic pediatric weights are typically 0.5–100 kg.

input_schema.name: volume
input_schema.description: Volume to be calculated in mL. Valid range: 1–5000 mL. May represent urine output, fluid intake, vomiting losses, etc.

input_schema.name: hours
input_schema.description: Period of time over which the volume was measured, in hours. Valid range: 0.999–24.001 hours.

name: PELD Score (Pediatric End-Stage Liver Disease) (younger than 12)
description: The PELD Score (Pediatric End-Stage Liver Disease) calculates the pediatric version of the MELD score for liver cirrhosis severity and transplant planning

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Patient age in years. Valid range: 0.1–11 years. Key threshold: < 2 years adds 0.436 to the weighted sum.

input_schema.name: albumin
input_schema.description: Serum albumin in g/L (SI unit; formula uses g/dL internally). Valid range: 10–60 g/L (equivalent to 1–6 g/dL). Converted via: g/dL = g/L / 10.

input_schema.name: bilirubin
input_schema.description: Total serum bilirubin in µmol/L (SI unit; formula uses mg/dL internally). Valid range: 0–342.08 µmol/L (equivalent to 0–20 mg/dL). Converted via: mg/dL = µmol/L / 17.104. Values < 1 mg/dL are floored to 1 mg/dL in the formula to avoid ln(0).

input_schema.name: inr
input_schema.description: International Normalized Ratio (dimensionless). Valid range: 0.5–10.

input_schema.name: growth_failure
input_schema.description: History of growth failure defined as height/weight < -2 standard deviations.

name: Ranson's Criteria for Pancreatitis Mortality
description: The Ranson's Criteria for Pancreatitis Mortality Estimates mortality of patients with pancreatitis, based on initial and 48-hour lab values.

input_schema.name: wbc_16k
input_schema.description: WBC >16,000/mm³ on admission. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

input_schema.name: age_55
input_schema.description: Age >55 years on admission. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

input_schema.name: glucose_200
input_schema.description: Glucose >200 mg/dL (>11.1 mmol/L) on admission. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

input_schema.name: ast_250
input_schema.description: AST >250 IU/L on admission. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

input_schema.name: ldh_350
input_schema.description: LDH >350 IU/L on admission. 0 = No, 1 = Yes.

input_schema.name: hct_10
input_schema.description: Hematocrit drop >10% from admission value within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

input_schema.name: bun_5
input_schema.description: BUN increase >5 mg/dL (>1.79 mmol/L) from admission within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

input_schema.name: ca_8
input_schema.description: Calcium <8 mg/dL (<2 mmol/L) within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

input_schema.name: po2_60
input_schema.description: Arterial pO2 <60 mmHg within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

input_schema.name: base_deficit_4
input_schema.description: Base deficit (24 − HCO3) >4 mEq/L within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

input_schema.name: fluid_needs_6
input_schema.description: Fluid needs >6 L within 48 hours. 0 = No, 1 = Yes. Optional; defaults to 0 (No).

name: Serum Osmolality/Osmolarity

input_schema.name: sodium
input_schema.description: Serum sodium concentration in mmol/L (equivalent to mEq/L). Valid range: 0–170 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: bun
input_schema.description: Blood urea nitrogen (BUN) in mmol/L. Valid range: 0.714–107.1 mmol/L (equivalent to 2–300 mg/dL). Conversion: 1 mg/dL = 0.357 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: glucose
input_schema.description: Serum glucose in mmol/L. Valid range: 2.775–55.5 mmol/L (equivalent to 50–1000 mg/dL). Conversion: 1 mg/dL = 0.0555 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: ethanol
input_schema.description: Serum ethanol/alcohol concentration in mmol/L. Optional; enter if measured for more accurate osmolarity estimation. Valid range: 0–86.8 mmol/L (equivalent to 0–400 mg/dL). Conversion: 1 mg/dL = 0.217 mmol/L. Defaults to None (omitted from formula).

input_schema.name: measured_serum
input_schema.description: Measured serum osmolality in mmol/kg (equivalent to mOsm/kg). Normal value is 285 mmol/kg. Valid range: 270–350 mmol/kg. Defaults to None (osmolar gap not calculated).

name: San Francisco Syncope Rule
description: The San Francisco Syncope Rule predicts risk for serious outcomes at 7 days in patients presenting with syncope or near-syncope.

input_schema.name: heart_failure
input_schema.description: History of congestive heart failure.

input_schema.name: hematocrit_30
input_schema.description: Hematocrit <30%.

input_schema.name: ekg_abnormal
input_schema.description: EKG abnormal — EKG changed, or any non-sinus rhythm on EKG or monitoring.

input_schema.name: shortness_of_breath
input_schema.description: Shortness of breath symptoms.

input_schema.name: systolic_bp_90
input_schema.description: Systolic BP <90 mmHg at triage.

name: Sodium Deficit in Hyponatremia

input_schema.name: age
input_schema.description: Age range category.

input_schema.name: weight
input_schema.description: Patient weight in kg. SI range: 1–226.8 kg.

input_schema.name: sodium
input_schema.description: Patient's current serum sodium in mmol/L. SI range: 0–170 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: desired_sodium
input_schema.description: Target/desired serum sodium in mmol/L. SI range: 0–170 mmol/L. Should be > sodium for deficit to be positive.

input_schema.name: age_no

input_schema.name: height

name: TIMI Risk Score for STEMI

input_schema.name: dm_hypertension_angina

input_schema.name: systolic_blood_pressure_100
input_schema.description: Systolic blood pressure < 100 mmHg at presentation.

input_schema.name: heart_rate_100
input_schema.description: Heart rate > 100 bpm at presentation.

input_schema.name: killip_class
input_schema.description: Killip Class II–IV (JVD or pulmonary exam findings of CHF).

input_schema.name: weight_67kg
input_schema.description: Weight < 67 kg (147.7 lbs).

input_schema.name: anterior_st_elevation_lbbb
input_schema.description: Anterior ST elevation or LBBB on ECG.

input_schema.name: treatment_time_4hrs
input_schema.description: Time to treatment (PCI or thrombolysis) > 4 hours.

input_schema.description: Stool sodium concentration in mmol/L. Valid range: 1-300 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: stool_potassium
input_schema.description: Stool potassium concentration in mmol/L. Valid range: 1-300 mmol/L.

input_schema.name: stool_osm
